page.overview:
Who is Bouncer Wasp?

The Bouncer Wasp is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"Flik hears a commotion across the busy street and looks over to see a wasp bouncing an unruly fly from Bennett's Bar. "I'll show you who's tough," the bouncer bug yells. "Get out and stay out!" It's all Flik needs to hear."
